basic_info.description: An exceptional condo located between Castro, Noe Valley, and Twin Peaks, with Kite Hill directly behind.This 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit features a panoramic window wall with stunning San Francisco cityscape views. The front deck spans the home's width, ensuring the open-plan living room, dining area, and kitchen are filled with natural light. The primary bedroom includes an ensuite bath and opens to a private, deeded patio. This outdoor oasis features a sitting area, hot tub, living wall, retractable canopy, and gate access to a common garden. Both bedrooms are generously sized and both bathrooms have been recently tastefully renovated. Situated on one story above a dedicated one-car garage, the property also includes additional loft storage, a dedicated laundry area, and an EV charger. There is a potential second parking spot available on the driveway. This stylish home offers a desirable alternative to a single-family home. It is also walkable to shops, restaurants, cafes, MUNI, tech shuttle stops, and parks. A must see!
